description: Build the `npx cronus-ui add ...` command for one or more components/blocks. The CLI resolves and installs each item's registry dependencies automatically. This only returns the command string — to actually install, use `install_component`.

names.description: One or more registry item names to install, e.g. ['button', 'card', 'dialog'].

title: Build a Cronus UI install command
